title: Finite-stage formula for the extended representing counit
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$, and a compactification $c$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $\mathcal C_H(T)$ and $\mathcal C_\Omega(T)$ for the bounded constructible condensed module-object categories and scalar functors $T^T_{H,H'}$, $T^T_{H,\Omega}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit], with $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ carrying the finite-subextension-valued condensed coefficient ring. Write $P_H$ and $P_\Omega$ for the fixed compact-support composites [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. The data structures and displayed equations are [def-pur-filtered-condensed-representing-pair-data]. Suppose $s$ is a canonical scalar comparison family, $E$ is a finite coefficient field and $d=(M,L,t,\beta)$ is a supplied compatible representing pair at $E$: $t:P_E M\to L$ and for each $H\supset E$, natural bijections $\beta_{H,C}:\operatorname{Hom}(C,T^X_{E,H}M)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(P_HC,T^Y_{E,H}L)$ given by the scalar-extended counit formula. Put $t_\Omega=T^Y_{E,\Omega}(t)\circ s_{E,\Omega,M}^{-1}$. For $H\supset E$, $C\in\mathcal C_H(X)$ and $a:C\to T^X_{E,H}M$, applying $P_\Omega$ to $T^X_{H,\Omega}(a)$ followed by the transitivity isomorphism to $T^X_{E,\Omega}M$, and then composing with $t_\Omega$, equals $s_{H,\Omega,C}^{-1}$ followed by $T^Y_{H,\Omega}(\beta_{H,C}(a))$ and the transitivity isomorphism to $T^Y_{E,\Omega}L$. This is equality of morphisms in $\mathcal C_\Omega(Y)$, with exactly the tensor-transitivity isomorphisms recorded in constructibleToPadicAlgClCompIso; it asserts no bijectivity.

proof.text:
substitute the finite counit formula Pair.IsCompatible into the right side.
Naturality of the closure scalar comparison moves the scalar extension of the test
map to the left. The projection composition equation identifies the two successive
inverse projection comparisons, followed by the tensor transitivity comparison,
with the single inverse comparison at E. The scalar-transitivity isomorphism on Y
is natural in t. These two equalities give the displayed equation by associativity.
The IsCanonical equations transfer the original projection coherence through the
faithful constructible inclusions. For H=E the same composition equation applies;
no identity scalar functor is treated as a definitional identity.

lean.statement:
theorem counit_finite_formula {s : ScalarComparisons l k c}
    (hs : s.IsCanonical l k c) {E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l}
    (d : Pair l k c s E) (hd : d.IsCompatible l k c)
    (H : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (h : E ≤ H)
    (C : PadicSubfieldConstructible X.left l H)
    (a : C ⟶ (constructibleExtendScalars X.left l h).obj d.M) :
    (omegaSupport l k c).map
        ((constructibleToPadicAlgCl X.left l H).map a ≫
          (constructibleToPadicAlgClCompIso X.left l h).hom.app d.M) ≫
        d.omegaCounit l k c =
      (s.omega H).inv.app C ≫
        (constructibleToPadicAlgCl Y.left l H).map (d.beta H h C a) ≫
          (constructibleToPadicAlgClCompIso Y.left l h).hom.app d.L
